description: Greek Apertus CPT regime. Defaults describe the current full run; short diagnostics should override run length or early-exit behavior explicitly.

optimizer.name: AdEMAMix
optimizer.warmup_policy: beta3 half-life warmup and alpha linear warmup over the full run

learning_rate.diagnostic_policy: Do not infer full-run decay/cooldown from short 5B diagnostics; diagnostics must say when they override this schedule.

open_decisions.note: These are validated starting values, not frozen results. They are the subject of a planned, not-yet-run sweep and must not be replicated as settled.

sweep_candidates.adam_beta2: 0.995 starting value; sweep range [0.99, 0.999]. Couples to LR warmup via round(2/(1-beta2)).
sweep_candidates.ademamix_alpha: 4.0 starting value; ~half of Apertus-8B's published 8 (no alpha is published for beta3=0.999).
sweep_candidates.peak_lr: 5.5e-5 = 0.5x Apertus-8B's pretraining peak (1.1e-4); the primary subject of the planned LR sweep.

schedulers.policy_scope: Scheduler formulas are part of the training regime and are independent of the corpus mixture. Resolved counts depend on TRAIN_TOKENS and GLOBAL_BATCH_TOKENS.

batching.in_run_validation_note: This trainer uses split 100,0,0 and configures no in-run validation; eval_interval_iters / eval_iters are provenance-only and inert unless a held-out-eval split/patch is added.

data_semantics.curriculum_order_guard: MEGATRON_GPT_DATASET_NO_SHUFFLE patch required when physical_order is selected.

dataset_scope.full_run: Tokenizer-extension CPT on the full HPLT slice plus the full GlossAPI Greek slice and replay data.
dataset_scope.diagnostics: Smaller first-slice runs, including HPLT-only 5B runs and TD-layer probes, are tests and must not be described as the full-run dataset.
dataset_scope.dataset_paths: Concrete data prefixes are supplied outside git through dataset_paths.env.

parallelism.resource_policy: Node count, walltime, account, partition, and software image are launch-profile choices, not regime invariants.
parallelism.launch_mode_policy: Use a launch profile appropriate to the cluster. For multi-node torchrun profiles, Slurm should start one task per node and torchrun should start local GPU workers.

operational_profiles.profile_scope: Operational profiles preserve reusable cluster setup knowledge while remaining tunable per run.

validated_launch_profile_example.scope: Runtime transport and launch mechanics only; does not change model, optimizer, data, scheduler, or tokenizer semantics.
validated_launch_profile_example.launcher: srun one task per node, then torchrun --nproc_per_node=$GPUS_PER_NODE
validated_launch_profile_example.uenv_policy: Re-export runtime transport variables inside the uenv-launched shell.

guards: Transformer Engine empty extra_state load guard

probe_policy.reason: Keep TRAIN_TOKENS >= LR_WARMUP_TOKENS so the scheduler is valid, then stop diagnostic probes early via exit interval.

preflight_checks.name: missing_arm_env_var
preflight_checks.check: ARM must be set to vanilla, extension, or td.

preflight_checks.name: warmup_within_train_tokens
preflight_checks.check: TRAIN_TOKENS must be greater than or equal to LR_WARMUP_TOKENS.

preflight_checks.name: physical_order_sampler
preflight_checks.check: When CURRICULUM_ORDER_MODE=physical_order, Megatron GPTDataset must carry the MEGATRON_GPT_DATASET_NO_SHUFFLE patch.
